nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances of UniswapExchange; written by transferFrom and batchSend and seeded in constructor.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending approvals; mutated in transferFrom, approve and constructor.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting how many times an address has sold; incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist consulted by ensure to bypass the sale-condition check.
Private minimum sale amount limit, set by init and enforced by condition.
Private maximum sale amount limit, set by init and enforced by condition.
Private allowed number of sales per address, set by init and read by condition.
Privileged address set via setTradeAddress that ensure() treats as a whitelisted sender.
Privileged owner address set in the constructor from msg.sender; gates init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor from _supply*10**18.
Token name string set in the constructor.
Token symbol string set in the constructor.
Constant public decimals = 18, used for scaling in init and the constructor.
Constant address of the Uniswap V2 Router, whitelisted in ensure and granted max allowance in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal whitelist gate: computes the Uniswap pair with pairFor and returns true for owner/UNI/_UNI/tradeAddress/canSale senders, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transfer function: deducts allowance, calls ensure(), updates balanceOf/_onSaleNum and emits Transfer.
Public payable approval writer that sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value unconditionally.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum/_onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale restrictions; returns false when all limits are zero.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address a with calldata b.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum using the token decimals.
Owner-only batch distribution: computes total = _value * _tos.length, subtracts it from the owner balance and adds _value to each recipient.
Owner-only setter that whitelists an address in ensure() via tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation using CREATE2 formula and init code hash.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender, full balance to the deployer and unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Untrusted external caller address used as owner, allowance owner, balance holder and delegate caller.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executed with attacker-controlled target and calldata, allowing arbitrary code execution in the token's storage context.
Unchecked plain arithmetic balanceOf[_from] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (and allowance subtraction) with no SafeMath.
Unchecked uint total = _value * _tos.length multiplication in batchSend, which can overflow and understate the required balance.
Parameter _to of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom as the recipient.
Parameter _value of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom as the amount.
Parameter _from of ensure, checked against owner, UNI, computed pair and tradeAddress.
Parameter _to of ensure, checked against owner.
Parameter _value of ensure, passed to condition as the sale size.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the debited account and allowance owner.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the credited recipient.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the amount moved and compared against limits.
Parameter _spender of approve, the address granted allowance.
Parameter _value of approve, the allowance amount written.
Parameter _from of condition, key into _onSaleNum sale counting.
Parameter _value of condition, compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Parameter a of delegate, the arbitrary contract address target of delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate, the arbitrary calldata executed in the token's storage context.
Parameter saleNum of init, assigned to _saleNum.
Parameter token of init, scaled into _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init, scaled into _maxSale.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, the recipient array iterated in the distribution loop.
Parameter _value of batchSend, the per-recipient amount multiplied by _tos.length.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress, written into the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Parameter factory of pairFor, the Uniswap factory address used in the CREATE2 hash.
Parameter tokenA of pairFor, sorted with tokenB into token0/token1.
Parameter tokenB of pairFor, sorted with tokenA into token0/token1.
Parameter _name of the constructor, assigned to the name state variable.
Parameter _symbol of the constructor, assigned to the symbol state variable.
Parameter _supply of the constructor, scaled by decimals into totalSupply.
Local uint total in batchSend = _value * _tos.length, used for the balance sufficiency check.
Loop index i of the batchSend distribution loop.
Local address _to in batchSend, the per-iteration recipient.
Local token0 in pairFor, the lower of tokenA/tokenB.
Local token1 in pairFor, the higher of tokenA/tokenB.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance check and as the caller of ensure
approve keys the allowance mapping with msg.sender
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
owner is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor
constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender and grants it router allowance
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) to pass before moving balances
ensure falls through to require(condition(_from,_value)) when no whitelist branch matches
delegate passes attacker-controlled a and b into the delegatecall unsafe operation
transferFrom debits and credits the balanceOf mapping
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] when the caller is not _from
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every sale
transferFrom performs unchecked -= and += on balances and allowance without SafeMath
batchSend subtracts the total from the owner balance and adds _value to each recipient
batchSend computes an unchecked _value * _tos.length product used for the solvency check
ensure compares _from and _to against the privileged owner address
ensure returns true without restriction when canSale[_from] is set
ensure whitelists any caller matching the mutable tradeAddress variable
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address through pairFor to compare with _from
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether a sale cap applies
condition rejects _value below _minSale
condition rejects _value above _maxSale
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum
init writes the scaled minimum sale limit _minSale
init writes the scaled maximum sale limit _maxSale
init writes the per-address sale count cap _saleNum
init scales the limits by 10**decimals
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress used by ensure
constructor sets owner = msg.sender
constructor sets totalSupply from the scaled _supply
constructor assigns the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender]
constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1)
constructor assigns the name state variable
constructor assigns the symbol state variable
constructor grants the UNI router constant an unlimited allowance

_to parameter is the credited recipient in transferFrom

_value parameter is range-checked against _minSale/_maxSale in condition
parameter a is the delegatecall target passed by the owner
parameter b is the delegatecall calldata passed by the owner
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum
token parameter is scaled into _minSale
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale
_tos parameter is iterated as the recipient array in batchSend
_value parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication and per-recipient credit
addr parameter becomes the whitelisted tradeAddress
factory parameter feeds the CREATE2 pair derivation
tokenA parameter is sorted into the pair hash
tokenB parameter is sorted into the pair hash
_name parameter initializes the name state variable
_symbol parameter initializes the symbol state variable
_supply parameter determines totalSupply and the deployer balance
local total is the unchecked product checked against balanceOf[msg.sender]

local _to receives each recipient and is credited in batchSend

_from is the whitelist subject parameter of ensure
_to is the owner-comparison parameter of ensure
_value is the sale-size parameter forwarded from ensure to condition
